changes: Explicit issue/PR resolution verifies canonical repository, viewer write access, open state, target URL/number, trusted author and same-repository PR identity before execution.
Background run_once and targeted execution now share run_selected, rather than implementing a second simplified workflow.
Targeted issues bypass unrelated automatic selection; targeted PRs enter the existing managed/source-less resume engines. Existing issue workflow PR/source bindings are preserved.

Local execution requires an explicit resolved target and validates runtime, requested-builder roles and resources; it does not require equality with running deployed services. Background execution retains deployment equality checks.
A scoped command lane selects the existing combined/build lock and candidate namespace, then restores the surrounding lane without environment mutation.
Durable queued request lookup checks its target against the workflow/PR alias and supports pre-command stores read-only.

resolution_green.boundary: real temporary Git repo; scripted GitHub reads; no model calls or workflow/worktree creation

limits: No public run/work-once command or automatic queue consumer is exposed by this change.
A complete native issue/PR run through the new targeted entry point remains unverified.
Queued approved work still needs targeted free reconciliation rather than repeating productive stages.
Wait/pause/cancel/resume/model commands, Discord sessions/updates, production rollout and live soak remain open.
